title: A Archive for the Terminal
author: Cyrus Thornbury
blurb: Ines Delacroix, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, has spent five years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
